name: Prologue complete (evening)
description: Both prologue quests done; Tomorrow's Heading points at the captain's bed.

name: Chapter 1: Morning on the Sapphire Sea
Chapter 3: Meet Garrick at the treasure door
Phase 4 Start
description: The captain has just slept after Phase 3. Morning; the ration is in the galley.

name: Morning Frog Grog
description: Arriving in the galley for the morning ration (the scene plays on arrival).

name: First Forecast
description: Garrick has unrolled the first crayon forecast on the breakfast table.

name: Breakfast Evacuation
description: 'That might be now.' The Center is in the galley; get up the ladder.

name: Life Around Center
description: Day 2 begins: the bell protocol is on the foremast.

name: Washroom Incident
description: Three bells: the Center is in the washroom with Gristle. Arriving in the crew quarters.

name: Galley Incident
description: Noon: the Center is sitting on Jim's stove. Close the stovepipe damper.

name: Night Evacuation
description: Three in the morning, three bells. Squawks is at the foot of the bed.

name: Quarterdeck Blocked
description: After the night: arriving on deck, the Center settles on the quarterdeck (the scene plays on arrival).

name: Seven Feathers
description: Day 6: Squawks wants his feathers counted, in the cabin.

name: Bald Again
description: The cloud has left the cabin. Take Squawks back in (the feathers fall on arrival).

name: Shark Duty
description: Day 7: the captain is on the roster. Take a pole from Jory's barrel.

name: Hundreds of Sharks
description: 'HOW MANY?' 'HUNDREDS.' Hold both rails.

name: Dead Center Shark Frenzy
description: Garrick has refused; three bells, the Center is heading for the port rail. Get Squawks.

name: Post-Frenzy Repairs
description: Late afternoon: the Center has moved off. Three repairs on the port rail.

name: Center Returns
description: Repairs done. Garrick has the afternoon forecast.

name: Final 700% Forecast
description: THE CENTER IS COMING BACK. Evacuate aft (or forward) for the last scenes and tomorrow's forecast.

name: Phase 4 Complete
description: Tomorrow: VERY BAD, 700%. The ship is free to explore.

name: Phase 5 Start
description: The morning after the 700% forecast. Make the rounds; Garrick is in a chair, facing a sheet.

name: Dead Center Panic
description: Rounds done. Three bells at the mainmast, and Squawks's basket is in the way. Grab him and get aft.

name: Squawks Check
description: Squawks is safe, aft, and fully bald. Check on him.

name: Grand Stenchmaster Duties
description: The first watch is over. Ask the Grand Stenchmaster what he actually does.

name: S.E.S. Reveal
description: The Stenchmaster Entertainment System has been unveiled. Have a look at it.

name: Shark Duty
description: Noon: hold both rails while the Grand Stenchmaster supervises from his chair.

name: Stenchmaster Suit Reveal
description: Garrick was found sewing in the hold. The crew are assembled on deck. Here it comes.

name: Crew Furious
description: The suit can't go near sharks (it's formalwear). Patch the starboard rail while he boasts.

name: Combined Emergency
description: Evening: more sharks than ever, the Center on the quarterdeck, Squawks by the wheel.

name: Night S.E.S. Scene
description: The labour rule is nailed up, Squawks is asleep. Look in on the S.E.S.

name: Phase 5 Complete
description: 'Programming.' 'Executive readiness.' The ship is free to explore.

name: Phase 6 Start
description: Sunset, a few days on. The suit has a saucepan lid on it now. Check on Squawks.

name: Rotten Garlic Supper
description: Garrick has the jar. Get down to the galley (with Squawks).

name: Frog Tax Man
description: Night. BWAAAAAH. Watch the S.E.S. with the Grand Stenchmaster.

name: S.E.S. Shutdown
description: Garrick won't wake; the set is sparking at full volume. Turn it off yourself: the knobs.

name: S.E.S. Death Rattle
description: OFF MAYBE worked. The set is dying anyway: crew to keep back, smoulders to smother, a barrel to move.

name: Almost Fires
description: After the POP: an ember on the Grand Stenchmaster's cape. The captain thinks about it.

name: Garrick Wakes
description: Dawn. 'WHO TURNED IT OFF?' Tell him what happened.

name: S.E.S. Apparently Dead
description: After Shark Duty: remind him of the labour rule. ('Throw it overboard.')

name: Midnight Warning
description: That night, in the sleeping quarters: Garrick wakes, and knows.

name: Sleeping Quarters Evacuation
description: Squawks is in your coat. Get the sleepers moving, then up the ladder.

name: Main Deck Refuge
description: On deck in the dark. Find somewhere safe. There isn't anywhere.

name: Final Warning
description: The countdown: 'Tradition starts somewhere.' Then BRACE.

name: Major Release
description: The mightiest gust yet: the ship inflates, the broadside goes off.

name: Second Yellow Apocalypse
description: A new cloud on the forward deck, garlic-pale. Get aft.

name: Shark Frenzy
description: Look over the port rail: the sharks have gone mad.

name: Great Sharkstorm Formation
description: The frenzy turns into a ring, a whirlpool, a column. Then a name.

name: Great Sharkstorm Attack
description: Sharks in the sky. Brace the shrouds, shelter Squawks, watch the shadows.

name: S.E.S. Shark Strike
description: The storm drinks the cloud; then a shark comes through the rail into the S.E.S.

name: Stinkbeard Breaking Point
description: Take the helm. Then the monologue. Then 'No.'

name: Frog Grog Discovery
description: A shark lands in the bulk reserve, swallows, and throws itself overboard.

name: Frog Grog Offensive
description: Roll barrels to the port rail and launch them into the storm.

name: Storm Driven Away
description: The column has collapsed. Everyone thinks it's dead. Look at the horizon.

name: Phase 6 Complete
description: The storm is on the horizon; the second cloud has the sleeping quarters; Garrick is banned from garlic for ever.

name: Phase 7 Start
description: Two days after Phase 6. Repairs, complaints, and the storm on the horizon nobody's looking at.

name: Sharkstorm Returning
description: Repairs done; Ned has called you forward. Look through the telescope.

name: Flying Sharks Return
description: THWACK. The storm is back on top of the ship. Which away?

name: Garrick TV Complaint
description: The rigging's fast, the main's reefed, Squawks is in your coat, the course is AWAY. The Grand Stenchmaster is shouting.

name: Not a Stenchmaster Duty
description: Franklin has an audit hearing tonight. The crew want the labour rule read out (the mainmast).

name: Grand Sharkmaster Argument
description: You have the rule in your hand. Read it to him (his chair).

name: Crew Job Revolt
description: A Grand Sharkmaster. The crew are gathering midships with a list.

name: Cape Shark
description: The list is complete. Take it to the Grand Stenchmaster (and mind the sky).

name: Stenchmaster Parade
description: The cape is torn; the crew chased him; now he's on parade. Help Pete, Bob and Jim.

name: Stenchmaster Song
description: One job left (Jim's crate). Then he sings.

name: S.E.S. Mark I Wrecked
description: The song is over. A shark finished the original S.E.S. Garrick is taking the ship apart for parts (the binnacle first).

name: Retreat Below
description: The storm worsens. Lash the wheel, then everyone below.

name: Mark II Construction
description: In the hold, sheltering. Watch the Grand Stenchmaster build a television (his bench).

name: Mark II Startup
description: Mark II is built. Keep his hands off the switch (talk to him). Twice.

name: Franklin Returns
description: It's on: snow, an orange tube, a suspicious blue one. The knobs (the set).

name: Crew Watches Frog Tax Man
description: Franklin is back. Nobody is watching it. Find something else to do.

name: Phase 7 Complete
description: The crew below, watching Franklin explain depreciation, the Great Sharkstorm overhead.

name: Phase 8 Start
description: The next afternoon (or so). A day and a half in the hold; the storm walking about on the roof. See how everyone's managing.

name: Lower Hull Shelter
description: Everyone's wedged in. Sit down in your corner, with Squawks: Franklin's being audited.

name: Garrick Rumbling
description: GLOOOORP. GRRRRRNNNK. Every head has turned. Somebody has to ask him (his chair).

name: False Alarm
description: 'I don't know.' 'Oh.' 'Ohhhh.' Full emergency: protect Squawks (your corner), then the stairs.

name: Sash Bearer Request
description: A false alarm. The fart is sneaky. No rowboat. Now he's looking at his sash (his chair).

name: Lost Fart Expedition
description: Nobody volunteered. FART SASH. Now: the costume trunk (by his chair).

name: Grand Crown Reveal
description: Professor Barnacle Bob is in his helmet. Now he's putting something on his own head (him).

name: Stinkbeard Fury
description: The crown, the premise, the landmarks (all in this room). That's enough. Hand Squawks to Gristle.

name: Sleeping Quarters Condemned
description: The storm eased, the Center moved on, Pete cracked the door: the fart took residence. Nail up the sign.

name: Lower Hull Barracks
description: The Grand Decree: the hold is the barracks now. Build it (hammocks, sailcloth, the floor, Squawks's bed, four bunks).

name: Barracks Complete
description: Everyone's sorted. Have a look at your own bunk (and what's over it).

name: Bedtime Story
description: Lights out. Get into your bunk. (He has a book.)

name: Grand Nap Start
description: The legend is told (the moral: hold the sash). He's getting into his hammock. In full attire.

name: Suit Fume Bunk
description: He's up there. You're under him. FWOoF.

name: Crown Fall
description: Bad bunk. Everyone drifts off. Then the crown slips.

name: Sash Descends
description: The crown's in a crate. Back in your bunk. Nearly asleep. Something touches your forehead.

name: Discount Store Reveal
description: LAST WEEK. Seventy per cent off. Cash only. No refunds. Wake the crew with the evidence (Pete, Gristle, Bob).

name: Phase 8 Complete
description: The sash cost three. NO ADVENTURE. Nobody slept; at three in the morning, Franklin's capital gains.

name: Phase 9 Start
description: The morning after the Grand Nap: grey light, nobody slept (except him). Starts the chapter 55 morning.

name: Morning After Grand Nap
description: Everyone's checked on (rope, a waffle, nine hundred and twelve snores, the butter). Wake him (the hammock over your bunk).

name: Sash History Lesson
description: He's on his rug with his crayon pictures. Ask him everything. Look interested.

name: Princess Stenchalina Story
description: The Sacred Stench is explained (and a CLEARANCE sticker seen). Now: who wore the sash first?

name: Five Grand Treasures
description: The ribbon fluttered; it's a fart sash in his own story. Now the Five Grand Treasures (Jim's bowl among them).

name: Discount Sash Confrontation
description: All of it heard, Admiral Thunderpants included. Thank him. Warmly. Then the discount bin.

name: Lost Fart Attempt Three
description: The witnesses have spoken. NO RECEIPT. Spiritual age; the plain purpose; the explorer's hat (attempt three).

name: Sash Bureaucracy
description: The hat's in the trunk. He's looking at Bob (by the mast). Bob resigns first.

name: Plain-Language Admission
description: Titles, a second title, the org chart, a Herald refused. Make him say it plainly. (Then: LAND.)

name: Land Sighted
description: FART SASH HOLDER. LAAAAND. Ned's at the gap in the hull by the stairs.

name: Crownskull Isle Reveal
description: A pale beach, reefs, jungle, cliffs, a ridge like a crowned skull. Hold your map up to it.

name: Landing Strategy
description: MY treasure; it followed us ('Strong scent'). Council round the map (the board by the barrels).

name: Grand Sharkmaster Appointment
description: Six ways ashore, six ways to die. A Grand Nap requested; a Grand Sharkmaster revived. Who gets pointed at?

name: Frog Tax Man Sharkstorm Coincidence
description: FORTY SECONDS. And the Mark II has come on by itself (the Mark II, by the rug).

name: Pete's Landing Plan
description: Records eaten by a shark; a shark storm; poor record-keeping. Pete has a plan, and he's furious about it.

name: Lee-Side Approach
description: Up on deck. Bring her round south of the reef (the helm), lines fast (the capstan), the decoy EMPTY (port davits).

name: Decoy Boat
description: Helm, lines, decoy: done. Launch the decoy with Pete and watch the fins for a window (starboard rail).

name: Crownskull Landing
description: The lure's thrown; the boats are down. Row through the reef to the beach (sharks still come down in the channel).

name: Jungle Exploration
description: Ashore. Follow the map (trail, ford, broken tooth, statue, X), or look round first: it's your island.

name: Crimson Fortune Site
description: The statue points north. The clearing under the skull.

name: Digging Start
description: THE FORTUNE OF THE CRIMSON KINGS. Everyone's share promised (Squawks: a gold pouch). Seven floors. Dig at the X.

name: Garrick Quits Digging
description: The sand's out. Give the Grand Stenchmaster his turn with the shovel.

name: Excavation Proposal
description: Three floors down, four to go: days. He has a proposal.

name: Launch Sequence
description: NO. Then the howl, the birds, the crown rattling, the ground humming. Ask him.

name: Evacuation Run
description: Launch command acknowledged. RUN: west along the path out of the clearing, to the beach.

name: Western Beach Trap
description: Out onto the western beach... where the storm is too.

name: Ancient Ruins Shelter
description: Between a Sharkstorm and a Garrick: the ruins. Make the shelter (stone, brace, beam, cloth).

name: Final Warning
description: Eighty-five and a half per cent. Squawks is in his corner. Watch the clearing (step into a gap in the ruins' south wall).

name: Excavation Blast
description: THERE IS NO TEAM. FIRE IN THE HOLE.

name: Great Sharkstorm Inland
description: Bad digging. The storm smelled it and came in. Get back to Squawks in the shelter.

name: Great White Rain
description: Halfway across the ruins' yard, great whites coming down (marked first).

name: Megalodon Arrival
description: Back with Squawks. Then a shadow the size of the ship.

name: Treasure Exposed
description: The megalodon's in the lagoon. Down in the crater: the Crimson Fortune, exposed. It WORKED.

name: Treasure Blown Away
description: It worked... and it keeps going. MY MONEY. NOT THAT ONE.

name: Crowned Megalodon
description: The fortune's in the storm. Something small and bright falls out of it, towards the lagoon.

name: Treasure-Laden Sharkstorm
description: Pfft. The storm glitters; jewelled sharks go over. Go and look in the crater.

name: Stinkbeard Rage Shanty
description: Two per cent, reeking. A crowned megalodon. Something in the captain lets go.

name: Recovery Quest Unlocked
description: Vertical relocation; suit memory; richer than pirates (currently). WE MUST RECOVER IT.

name: Phase 9 Complete
description: IT. WINKED. Recover the Crimson Fortune (open). Crownskull Isle to wander; the boats go back to the Revenge.

name: Phase 10 Start
description: The Shark Shanty's over. Pete's hovering by the crater with his hands up: talk to him.

name: Grand Sharkmaster Blame Scene
description: Not Pete's fault. (He'd like that noted.) Then: I used to be Blackbeard. Starts chapter 71.

name: Crater Salvage
description: Search the rim for whatever came down again (the glints, south and east first).

name: Wealthy Shark Return Trail
description: Gristle's counted it. Down the jungle trail to the boats, under the wealthy sharks.

name: Back Aboard Ship
description: The tiara's gone again. The boats: row back to the Revenge. She looks terrible.

name: Bling Bling King Reveal
description: Aboard. A shadow under the bow. Something comes up in a chain.

name: Participation Coin
description: It spat something on the deck. Pick it up. Read it. Both sides.

name: Beans Pantry
description: A celebration (allegedly). Jim's in the hold, by his pantry. Whatever you're imagining, it's beans.

name: Crying Beans Dinner
description: Beans and Frog Grog. Up to the galley to cook: Crying Beans, the pot, the sauce. Stop him.

name: Luxury Shark Seafood
description: Dinner was terrible. Up on deck: the sharks have ordered catering.

name: Shark Leftovers
description: They paid with your crown and threw the rubbish on your deck. Sweep the three heaps over the side.

name: Sleeping Quarters Test
description: A vat vented in the hold. Rusty Tom volunteers to check the old quarters (the boarded door in the galley).

name: Luxury Bedding
description: Still condemned. Ned's seen something on deck: the barge is back, with bedding.

name: Galley Barracks
description: One pillow, communal. The galley is a bedroom tonight: sacks, Squawks' basket, your spot.

name: Brogath Alleged Legend
description: The Frog Tax Man's done; the lamp's down. A bedtime story (the Grand Stenchmaster's hammock).

name: Bedtime Mockery
description: Brogath the Bashful (alleged). Something's coming down the hatch. It's plastic.

name: Rumpold Legend
description: A word with the storm, done. Back below: ask him about weather (his hammock).

name: Stinkbeard Research
description: The book's yours, for the night. Read the Rumpold chapter properly (the long table).

name: 53x Warning
description: All of it read. Write it up, consequences and all (the long table).

name: Counter-Sharkstorm Briefing
description: ALL HANDS ON DECK. Brief the crew (the board, by the mainmast).

name: Pete Bureaucracy Reversal
description: Approved. He needs sash holders. Find volunteers (Pete has a list of duties).

name: Sash Holder Selection
description: Fake job duties for everyone. Draw lots (the board).

name: Charging Feast Start
description: Rusty Tom and Barnacle Bill (not related). He needs charging: the Grand Feast. Starts chapter 89.

name: Bean Smoothie
description: Three courses done. The blender on the long table. It has a fork in it.

name: One-Bite Feast
description: Plated, formally. Serve the Grand Stenchmaster.

name: Garrick Fully Charged
description: He ate it all in one bite. <k>gloooorp</>. Up on deck: the storm's close.

name: Great Sharkstorm Approach
description: Get her ready: sheets, cargo, ropes, the helm, the galley, the sash holders. Watch for the marks.

name: Cowardice Crisis
description: 'Many sharks. They look angry.' THIS IS THE ONE TIME. Get him to the stern (him).

name: Cowardice Award
description: Three arguments at the bow. Something's coming down for him.

name: Final Alignment
description: Back at the stern (the sash fluttered). Bring her stern round to the centre (the helm).

name: Wrong-Way Release
description: ...nope. STENCHMASTER LAUNCH. NOT INTO THE OCEAN!

name: Ocean Contamination
description: The sea in front of the bow goes UP. Why is it green?

name: Fart Propulsion
description: BEANS. And then the ship starts to move. Backwards.

name: Great Sharkstorm Entry
description: Straight into the Great Sharkstorm. HOLD ON (the rail). Then Squawks. Then below.

name: Inside Great Sharkstorm
description: Down the hatch, everybody. The galley tips. She's going ROUND. Starts chapter 93.

name: Galley Bunker
description: Inside. Tokens, prepared in advance. Back down the ladder: he feels FANTASTIC.

name: S.E.S. Signal Failure
description: NO AFTERSHOCKS. The galley tips; he saves the television. Snow.

name: Spicy Sauce Antenna
description: No signal. Fiddle with the aerial (the Mark II, by the stores).

name: Frog Tax Man Storm Audit
description: A picture, via a can of sauce. Franklin's on. Watch (the Mark II).

name: Bling Bling King TV Interview
description: The storm's largest account holder joins Franklin. It talks.

name: Fake Transfer Doctrine
description: 'Eats, sleeps, watches television.' Now it's quoting his book. Chapter Forty-Seven.

name: Bling Bling King Tax Payment
description: That's made up! Do you take pirate crowns?

name: Bling Bling King Commercial
description: PAID. And now a word from Bling Bling King Treasure Solutions.

name: Blackbeard Breakdown
description: There is a SHARK. On the TELEVISION. Starts chapter 95.

name: Phase 10 Complete
description: Good night, Fart Man. The Revenge is inside the Great Sharkstorm, still trapped. The nap can wait.

name: Phase 11 Start
description: Good night, Fart Man. Bedtime, inside the Great Sharkstorm: your bed (the galley, by the stores).

name: Grand Bedtime Argument
description: Lights out, nearly. The Grand Stenchmaster has a book and opinions about hammocks. Starts chapter 96.

name: Lamp Engineering
description: Too dark to read by. Hang the kerosene lamp properly: rope, leather, the rig, then six ropes. Starts chapter 97.

name: Brogath Bedtime Legend
description: The lamp holds (it really works). A bedtime story: Brogath the Bashful and his treasure. Starts chapter 98.

name: Finger-Puller Revelation
description: Every sash incident on record, reviewed. Now: the Grand Finger-Puller, and a vote. Starts chapter 100.

name: Token Downpour
description: Elected (unwillingly). The storm has been listening, and it has tokens. Starts chapter 101.

name: Hammock Failure
description: THE DESIGNATED FART MAN, says the storm. Then the hammocks start to go. Starts chapter 102.

name: Lost Book
description: Everybody's on the floor. Where's his book? Starts chapter 103.

name: Cheap-O-Rama Sashes
description: The book's gone into the storm. Something is coming down through it instead. Starts chapter 104.

name: Bed Sash Repairs
description: Three hundred sashes and a pocket edition. The hammocks need mending: with sashes. Starts chapter 106.

name: Grand Nap Resumption
description: Every bed is a sash bed. The Grand Nap resumes, grandly. Starts chapter 107.

name: Sir Rumpus Legend
description: One more story, about the law: Sir Rumpus Windbottom and the Grand Court. Starts chapter 108.

name: Bling Late-Night Show
description: Fart validity, settled (allegedly). The Mark II comes on by itself. Late. Starts chapter 109.

name: First Great Sash Flutter
description: The set's off. One last legend: the First Great Sash Flutter. Starts chapter 110.

name: Secret Book Borrow
description: Three weeks of silence, for a flutter. He's asleep, and the pocket edition is in his hammock. Starts chapter 111.

name: Grand Dice Discovery
description: Four passages read by lamplight. The very last page: two tables, and the Grand Dice of Grandness.

name: Anti-Dice Conspiracy
description: The plan's written and the booklet's back in his hammock. Wake the crew, quietly, one at a time.

name: Phase 11 Complete
description: Sworn: hold the sash thirty seconds, let it flutter, and no dice. Ever. Morning comes next (your bed).

name: Phase 12 Start
description: Morning, inside the Great Sharkstorm. Get up (your bed, the galley).

name: Garrick Loaded
description: He woke up loaded. Enormous pressure. Starts chapter 112.

name: Protective Gear
description: Gather protection: wet cloth (Jim's bucket), goggles (the hold), rope (by the Grog cask), beard wrap (your wardrobe).

name: Sash Volunteer
description: Geared up. Up on deck, somebody has to hold the sash. Starts chapter 113.

name: Pre-Waft
description: You volunteered. The old sash smells worse than your beard. And then the pre-waft. Starts chapter 114.

name: Thirty-Second Trial
description: Hold the sash. Thirty seconds. Pete counts. Starts chapter 115.

name: Flutter Moment
description: THIRTY. Open your hands. The storm finds the loose sash. Starts chapter 116.

name: Runaway Humiliation Blast
description: FULL FLUTTER, in front of everybody. And the shame makes it... worse.

name: Three Weeks Claimed
description: Witnessed, gasped at, complained about by the weather. THREE WEEKS. Starts chapter 117.

name: Dice Search
description: He's invoked the Grand Dice. Follow him below: drawers, beans, the table, the packages. Starts chapter 118.

name: Real Grand Dice Found
description: A normal die rolled a six (it doesn't count). The Cheap-O-Rama crate: something purple, and foam.

name: Grand Dice Shipment
description: No escape in the rules. And the Bling Bling King has sent six sets. Starts chapter 120.

name: Grand Dice Ceremony
description: Six Grand Dice. Inspect one, witness it, and let him roll. Starts chapter 121.

name: Apparent Three Months
description: Inspected and witnessed. He throws it. Low, low, low...

name: Jumping Bean Betrayal
description: THREE MONTHS! Everybody's celebrating. The die is... moving. Starts chapter 122.

name: One-Day Suspension
description: Three. ONE DAY. Read him the suspension rules: no title, no decrees, regalia off.

name: Authenticity Whiff
description: Just Garrick, for a day. The sash has to be authenticated. By the highest-ranking nose. Starts chapter 124.

name: Sash Wardrobe
description: Authentic. It's in your custody for the whole Silence: in your wardrobe, with your coats.

name: Normal Breakfast
description: The sash is in with your coats. Breakfast: a normal one, for once. Starts chapter 125.

name: Finger-Pulling Crisis
description: A whole normal breakfast. And now he's holding out his finger. Starts chapter 126.

name: Phase 12 Complete
description: Nobody pulled it. One day is apparently unbearable. Garrick, by the stove, has a few things to say.

name: Phase 13 Start
description: The suspension is going badly (for him). Talk to Garrick (the galley).

name: Sash Trash Comedy
description: Five loopholes, all refused. The sash in your wardrobe is next. Starts chapter 128.

name: Growling Bedding
description: Don't throw his sash in the trash (there's a song). Something in the old quarters is growling. Starts chapter 129.

name: Returned Pillow
description: The quarters are open, and the pillow growls. Throw it into the storm (the port rail).

name: Textile Closet
description: All the bedding judged and condemned. Stuff the pile into the linen locker, then nail it shut.

name: Sash Bedding
description: The locker's nailed. New bedding: the Cheap-O-Rama sashes. Starts chapter 131.

name: Mega-Pack
description: The quarters, made up in sashes. And another delivery: the Grand Stenchmaster Fan Mega-Pack. Starts chapter 132.

name: Cardboard Legends
description: Five life-size cardboard Ancient Stenchmasters. Put them up (you choose where).

name: Bedroom S.E.S. Build
description: The legends are up. A Build-Your-Own S.E.S. kit: find the parts. Starts chapter 133.

name: Antenna Routing
description: A second set. Wire the two together: behind Brogath, across the deck, the cannon, tape. Starts chapter 134.

name: Stenchmaster Channel
description: Connected. One channel. Starts chapter 135.

name: Stenchalina Programme
description: The Stenchmaster Channel. Tonight: Princess Stenchalina. Watch (the kit set).

name: Stench-O-Vision
description: Three hours, forty-one minutes of baby. Then the set starts to smell. Starts chapter 136.

name: Brogath Programme
description: Stench-O-Vision, adjusted. The Brogath special: Poor in Gold, Rich in Gas. Starts chapter 137.

name: Captain Rant
description: Enough. The standees, the bedding, the set, the locker, the Mega-Pack: ALL of it. Starts chapter 138.

name: Beard Delirium
description: The rant's over. You breathe in. Through the beard. Deeply. Starts chapter 139.

name: Ancient Stenchmasters
description: Every Ancient Stenchmaster is here (they are the crew). Meet them. Starts chapter 140.

name: Disarm Stenchmasters
description: Brogath, Rumpold, Rumpus, Gustavio, Stenchalina, Stenchmaster Prime. Disarm them. Starts chapter 141.

name: Deck Delirium
description: Every sash flutters at once. Up on deck: orders, before the apocalypse. Starts chapter 142.

name: Two Brogaths
description: Orders given. And there are two Brogaths. Starts chapter 143.

name: Treasure-Room Brogath
description: The real one touched the wheel. And something is growling in the treasure room. Starts chapter 144.

name: Captain Brogath
description: Which Brogath? Back on deck: Pete leaned on the helm, and that is a challenge for command. Starts chapter 145.

name: Brogath Command Crisis
description: Three gusts held, three campaign tokens. Then the growl from below, one more time.

name: Phase 13 Complete
description: Still inside the Great Sharkstorm. Garrick suspended, the sash in your wardrobe, the treasure room sealed, and Pete is Brogath.

name: Phase 14 Start
description: The night of the command crisis, inside the Great Sharkstorm, with ten real doubloons (and more) in your purse. Talk to Pete (the deck).

name: The Plume
description: The treasure-room door, opened a crack. Something got out. Starts chapter 147.

name: Brogath Returns
description: The plume went into the cardboard Brogath in the quarters. Starts chapter 148.

name: Containment Corner
description: Brogath the Bashful is aboard, and very polite. The barricade, the first rules, Garrick. Starts chapter 149.

name: Keep Brogath Confident
description: Flutter incidents: a shirt-tail, a label, a napkin, a page, a parrot, a flag. Starts chapter 150.

name: Apology Eruption
description: He apologises, and the apology flutters. Brace the quarters. Starts chapter 151.

name: Back in Office
description: Garrick's suspension ends: the sash, out of your wardrobe with the fire tongs. Starts chapter 152.

name: Two Grand Stenchmasters
description: Supremacy, in the galley. (The Grand Waft Trials are mentioned, never held.) Starts chapter 153.

name: Beans of Ancient Precedent
description: Compliments by turns, then breakfast. Starts chapter 154.

name: Fart-Free Zone
description: The little door under the hold stairs becomes the crew's refuge. Starts chapter 155.

name: Getting Rid of Brogath
description: Proposals, in the zone. Starts chapter 156.

name: Beyond Broke
description: The second treasure catastrophe, in the pocket edition. Starts chapter 157.

name: Grand Economy
description: Gust Pieces, Wind Crowns, Atmospheric Doubloons. Starts chapter 158.

name: Bad Money
description: Brogath has bought something with your money. Check your purse. Starts chapter 159.

name: Oat Security
description: Twenty thousand Grand Tokens (not gold) and ten doubloons fewer. Give Brogath a job. Starts chapter 160.

name: Television Duty
description: Brogath watches the Frog Tax Man. Starts chapter 161.

name: Sash Commercial
description: The Bling Bling King buys advertising. Starts chapter 162.

name: The Grand Bank
description: Seven questions, the Anger Waft, and a bank on the deck. Starts chapter 163.

name: Teller Shift
description: Your Gas Is Our Business: serve the queue at the counter. Starts chapter 164.

name: Legendary Depositors
description: The legends, and Grandmother Gustilda. Starts chapter 165.

name: Branch Concludes
description: The bank starts to go. Redeem the tokens (try). Starts chapter 166.

name: Distinguishedly Furious
description: Ten minutes and forty-seven seconds. Console him. Starts chapter 167.

name: The Brogath Problem
description: Disposal research in the zone, and the warning on the last page. Starts chapter 168.

name: History Night
description: Bedtime in the zone, and the Mark II upstairs. Starts chapter 169.

name: Phase 14 Complete
description: He lives here now: Ancient Historical Consultant. Licensed sashes on the Stenchmaster Channel. Still inside the Great Sharkstorm; the treasure room sealed.

name: Phase 15 Start
description: The morning after Mandatory History Night. The Mark II has been on for three days. Talk to Pete (the galley).

name: Top Ten Sash Flutters
description: Straight on after the Age of Fart Commerce: the countdown, the goat, and the first skunk waft. Starts chapter 171.

name: Family of Idiots
description: The Mark II gutted (for now). Brogath has gone quiet: his crew. Starts chapter 172.

name: Grand Economic Recovery
description: A Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Idea. The reserve, the crate, standing clear, Garrick's exercise. Starts chapter 173.

name: Creative Conversion
description: Twenty thousand tokens and seven doubloons, converted (once). A mountain of Skunk Weed. Starts chapter 174.

name: Stinkbeard's Select
description: The Sharkstorm spits a little boat onto the deck. Customers. Starts chapter 175.

name: The Chicken Incident
description: The Mark II is back on with no insides. Agnes, on television. Starts chapter 176.

name: The Grand Paranoia
description: In the zone: the beard-smoke catastrophe, and the threat levels. Starts chapter 177.

name: The Grand Nap
description: Garrick decrees a nap. Clean sash bedding; a growling pillow. Starts chapter 178.

name: The Nose-Fire Waft
description: The captain wakes, thinks he's in the zone, and says everything. Starts chapter 179.

name: Bashfulness Branch
description: OPEN SO LONG AS BROGATH REMAINS BASHFUL. The night depositors. Starts chapter 180.

name: The Great Mellowing
description: Something on a parachute, out of the Sharkstorm. Agnes the Second. Starts chapter 181.

name: The Untold Stories
description: Everyone mellow, nobody at their station, a sash advert on the Mark II. Starts chapter 182.

name: Relief Grand Teller
description: The branch teller clocks out. Ten customers. Starts chapter 183.

name: Relief Queue: Gary
description: Seven served. Next at the window: Gary. (Lunch.)

name: Relief Queue: Farthelmew
description: Nine served. Next at the window: Grand Emperor Farthelmew, who wants to deposit everything.

name: Sash-Backed Loan
description: The AFTER-HOURS EXPRESS WINDOW: Grand Lady Whifflebottom. Starts chapter 184.

name: The Fart He Misses
description: The branch closed for good. Peace, munchies, and then Vindicta. Starts chapter 185.

name: Phase 15 Complete
description: Not today. The Skunk Weed is the Emergency Mellowing Supply; the visitors are still aboard; Agnes the Second is in the Sharkstorm, on a pillow.

name: Phase 16 Start
description: A day after Vindicta. Everybody is themselves again, which is unbearable. Talk to Pete (the galley).

name: The Grand Lighter
description: No fire anywhere aboard. Shout into the Sharkstorm. Starts chapter 187.

name: Coffin Sock
description: Brogath tries for the green one on purpose. Starts chapter 188.

name: Stenchmaster Fart Zone
description: The old sail locker under the cargo grating becomes a release room. Starts chapter 189.

name: Vindicta's Emergency
description: Something clucks. Vindicta is READY. Starts chapter 190.

name: The Rescue (mid-190)
description: Procedure done: portholes open, door shut. Agnes is in there. Watch the gap, grab, run.

name: The Near-Miss
description: Agnes is back, and puts her head in the captain's beard. Starts chapter 191.

name: Chicken-Town
description: The chicken just needs to chicken. Starts chapter 192.

name: The Grand Dispensary
description: Brogath can do it while relaxed. A counter appears. Starts chapter 193.

name: The Sash Lounge
description: The crew's lounge; a song; Bankworth. Starts chapter 194.

name: Currency Converter
description: One token in, one Coffin Sock out. Starts chapter 195.

name: Grand Sashback Rewards
description: Credit by the foulness of the sash. Lady Rancidella. Starts chapter 196.

name: The Hornet Fart
description: Brogath wants to be useful. HORNETS. Starts chapter 197.

name: Behind the Rope (mid-197)
description: The posted procedure done: Brogath in the circle, door shut, portholes open. Sit on the bench and watch.

name: Stingbeard
description: The hornets have found the beard. Starts chapter 198.

name: Sash-Quote Story Hour
description: The speaking tube from the bunker. Starts chapter 199.

name: Hornet Credit Boom
description: BZBZBZBZZZZ-7 presses APPLY NOW. Starts chapter 200.

name: The Epidemic (mid-200)
description: They've ALL found out. Hornets at the counter, every one with a strand of your beard.

name: Lighter History
description: The hornets go home; the bunker at last; the lore book. Starts chapter 201.

name: Portable Set
description: A television out of Garrick's coat. Starts chapter 202.

name: 97-Page Application
description: The Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition. Lord Puffchester. Starts chapter 203.

name: Ignition Hearing
description: PRE-IGNITION REVIEW REQUIRED. The captain is the advocate. Starts chapter 204.

name: The Lighter Pitch
description: Vindicta in the middle of the room. A lighter that works sometimes. Starts chapter 205.

name: Phase 16 Complete
description: COMMON SENSE IS WINNING (sometimes). Agnes on Brogath's foot, Bankworth at the counter, the Sharkstorm still going round.

name: Old Crew Memories
description: A quiet night in the Fart-Free Zone. Brogath on the bedding with a slate and a pocket edition. Starts chapter 206 as you go in.

name: Cardboard Construction
description: Brogath has been busy on the north wall of the old quarters. Starts chapter 207.

name: Before the Door
description: He's gone to the hold with two cut-outs and a plan. The treasure-room door. Starts chapter 208.

name: Ledger and Tilda Return (mid-208)
description: The door's nailed shut again. A piece of it got out. Turn round.

name: The Reunion
description: Two cut-outs with somebody in them. Starts chapter 209.

name: Ledger's Financial Review
description: Ledger and Tilda in the party. Adult supervision. Starts chapter 210.

name: Tilda's Application
description: Tilda wants a light. The Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition, 97 pages. Starts chapter 211.

name: Old Crew Documentary
description: THE CREW HE LEFT BEHIND on the Mark II. Starts chapter 212.

name: The Greyhook Proposal
description: Ledger remembers where his books are. Tilda takes the wheel. Starts chapter 213.

name: The Converter Incident
description: Ledger has found a token. The converter is by the mast. Starts chapter 214.

name: The Late-Night Special
description: MEET THE NEW DEAD IDIOTS! Interruptions fail. Starts chapter 215.

name: Tilda's Ignition Preparation
description: The permit, the points, the conditions, the prep. Starts chapter 216.

name: The Grand Restraint (mid-216)
description: Portholes open, Agnes far away, Pete with buckets. Behind the rope in the Fart Zone.

name: The Fire-Sharkstorm
description: A shark hits the hull. A Fire-Waft. The storm overhead catches fire (for a while). Starts chapter 217.

name: Chicken-Town Again (mid-217)
description: You've got Agnes under your coat. The Fart Zone, across the burning deck.

name: Thunderbottom Arrives
description: Somebody rings the bell at the counter. Starts chapter 218.

name: Thunderbottom and Agnes (mid-218)
description: Lord Vaporious Thunderbottom the Seventh has seen the chicken. Stand between them.

name: Agnes in the Fart Zone
description: The cushion's empty. TEN. NINE. Starts chapter 219.

name: After the Rescue (mid-219)
description: Out, with her. Agnes on deck, fewer feathers than she had.

name: The Beard Exhales
description: Your beard has taken in a legendary release. Starts chapter 220.

name: Coffin Sock: Pending (mid-220)
description: Brogath has noticed something. COFFIN SOCK EVENT: PENDING. Emergency procedures.

name: The Beard Joint
description: Garrick, behind a sash screen, with scissors. Starts chapter 221.

name: Frog Grog (mid-221)
description: Something wrong with everybody's faces. Garrick has an improvement.

name: The Grand Paranoia Spiral (mid-221)
description: Who's in on it? Five suspects, two layers, clues.

name: Princess Stenchalina
description: HER. (It's Jim.) Starts chapter 222.

name: The Coffin Sock (mid-222)
description: The countdown's at the end. ...Brogath?

name: Phase 17 Complete
description: Partly recovered. Brogath proud. Everyone furious. Ledger and Tilda aboard; Greyhook Cove pending; the Sharkstorm still going round.

name: Ship Integrity demo
description: Overhaul Prompt 5 test bench (docs/gameplay-overhaul/09-ship-integrity.md): the end of Phase 17 in the crew quarters (a room the hulls are worked from), a whole ship and repair materials. Damage it from F2 > Ship; inspect and repair it from Pause > Ship.

name: Emergency demo
description: Overhaul Prompt 6 test bench (docs/gameplay-overhaul/10-flooding-and-fire.md): the end of Phase 17 in the cargo hold, by the bilge pump, with a whole ship and emergency supplies. Start a leak or a fire from F2 > Ship; respond with V (pad X) where it happens.

name: Air demo
description: Overhaul Prompt 7 test bench (docs/gameplay-overhaul/11-atmosphere-and-ventilation.md): the end of Phase 17 in the crew quarters, clean air everywhere, every opening at its default, with sealing and repair supplies. Start a gas scene from F2 > Ship; respond with V (pad X) in the room.

name: Pressure demo
description: Overhaul Prompt 8 test bench (docs/gameplay-overhaul/12-pressure-and-eruptions.md): the end of Phase 17 in the crew quarters, Brogath and Garrick where the story has them (both within reach), clean air, a healthy ship, sealing and repair supplies. Nobody's pressure is in play until a scenario from F2 > Ship switches it on; respond with V (pad X) in the room.
